sql: with f as (select market_ticker, min(created_at) as filled_at, sum(quantity) as qty, max(limit_price) as px from live_orders where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and status='filled' and side='no' and action='buy' and limit_price between 90 and 95 and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXGOLDD','KXBRENTD','KXNATGASD','KXWTI','KXWTIW','KXAAAGASD','KXAAAGASW','KXCOPPERD','KXBRENTW','KXGOLDW') group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), pp as (select market_ticker, count(*) as paper_rows, round(avg(pnl/nullif(quantity,0))*100,1) as paper_c from paper_trades where strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and strategy not ilike '%\_pt%' and side='no' and status in ('settled','closed_sl','closed_tp','closed_timeout') group by 1) select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, count(*) as live_mkts, sum(case when p.realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as live_losers, sum(case when pp.paper_rows>0 then 1 else 0 end) as paper_also, sum(case when pp.paper_c<0 then 1 else 0 end) as paper_also_lost, sum(case when p.realized_pnl<0 and coalesce(pp.paper_c,0)>=0 and pp.paper_rows>0 then 1 else 0 end) as live_lost_paper_won from f left join p using (market_ticker) left join pp using (market_ticker) group by 1 order by 2 desc
